base_url.description: YouTrack instance URL. Can also be set via TF_VAR_YOUTRACK_URL environment variable.

token.description: YouTrack API token. Can also be set via TF_VAR_YOUTRACK_TOKEN environment variable.

block.description: Youtrack base configuration for provider

id.description: Appearance settings identifier

block.description: YouTrack appearance settings configuration

allowed_create_new_users.description: Whether new users may be created on first login via this module. Defaults to false.

background_sync_enabled.description: Whether background synchronisation with the identity provider is enabled. Defaults to false.

client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID registered with the identity provider.

client_secret.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret. This value is write-only and is not returned by the API.

connection_timeout.description: Connection timeout in milliseconds when contacting the identity provider.

disabled.description: Whether the auth module is disabled. Defaults to false.

email_verified_by_default.description: Whether email addresses from this provider are considered verified by default. Defaults to false.

form_client_auth.description: Whether to send client credentials in the request body instead of the Authorization header. Defaults to false.

full_name_path.description: JSON path expression to the full name claim in the identity provider response.

icon_url.description: URL of a custom icon to display for this auth module.

id.description: Hub ID of the auth module (computed).

idp_logout_url.description: URL of the identity provider logout endpoint.

is_default.description: Whether this auth module is the default login method. Defaults to false.

name.description: Display name of the auth module.

read_timeout.description: Read timeout in milliseconds when contacting the identity provider.

redirect_uri.description: OAuth 2.0 redirect URI. When omitted, Hub sets this automatically.

scope.description: Space-separated list of OAuth 2.0 scopes to request.

server_url.description: Base URL of the OAuth 2.0 authorization server (identity provider).

sync_interval.description: Cron expression that controls background synchronisation frequency.

token_url.description: URL of the token endpoint at the identity provider.

user_avatar_url.description: URL used by Hub to retrieve the user's avatar from the identity provider.

user_email_path.description: JSON path expression to the email claim in the identity provider response.

user_email_url.description: URL used by Hub to retrieve the user's email address from the identity provider.

user_email_verified_path.description: JSON path expression to the email-verified claim in the identity provider response.

user_groups_path.description: JSON path expression to the groups claim in the identity provider response.

user_id_path.description: JSON path expression to the user ID claim in the identity provider response.

user_info_url.description: URL of the userinfo endpoint at the identity provider.

user_name_path.description: JSON path expression to the username claim in the identity provider response.

user_picture_id_path.description: JSON path expression to the picture ID claim in the identity provider response.

user_picture_url_pattern.description: URL pattern used to build the picture URL from the picture ID.

block.description: Manages a Hub OAuth 2.0 authentication module. This resource allows configuring an external OAuth 2.0 identity provider for Hub.

aliases.description: Comma-separated aliases used in search and commands.

bundle_id.description: Referenced default bundle ID for bundle-based field types.

bundle_name.description: Referenced default bundle name. Supported as input for enum[1] and state[1] bundle-based fields.

can_be_empty.description: Whether issues may keep this field empty.

default_value_names.description: Default values for bundle-based enum/state fields, resolved by value name from the referenced bundle.

empty_field_text.description: Placeholder text shown when the field is empty.

field_defaults.description: Default project-related settings for the custom field.

field_type_id.description: YouTrack field type identifier (for example: enum[1], state[1], string). This value is immutable after creation.

field_type_presentation.description: Field type presentation returned by YouTrack.

has_running_job.description: Whether a background job is running for this field.

id.description: The ID of the custom field.

is_auto_attached.description: Whether the field is attached automatically to new projects.

is_displayed_in_issue_list.description: Whether the field is displayed in the issue list by default.

is_updateable.description: Whether current user can update this custom field.

name.description: The name of the custom field.

ordinal.description: The numeric order of the field.

block.description: YouTrack custom field resource. This resource manages system custom fields.

archive_format.description: Archive format for backups (ZIP or TAR_GZ)

files_to_keep.description: Number of backup files to keep

id.description: Backup settings identifier

notified_users.description: List of YouTrack user logins notified about backup status

block.description: YouTrack database backup settings configuration

id.description: The ID of the enum bundle.

is_updateable.description: Whether current user can update this bundle.

archived.description: Whether this enum value is archived.

id.description: enum value ID.

block.description: YouTrack enum bundle resource. This resource manages sets of enum values.

id.description: The ID of the global settings configuration.

license.description: The license key for the YouTrack instance. Can be null if no license is configured.

block.description: YouTrack global settings resource. This resource manages the global settings in YouTrack, specifically the license configuration.

attribute_prototypes.description: Read-only list of global work item attribute prototypes and their values.

id.description: The ID of the global time tracking settings configuration.

auto_attached.description: When true, this type is automatically added to a project when time tracking is enabled.

name.description: Name of the work item type.

work_item_types.description: Set of work item types to manage. When set, this set is the source of truth: types present here are created or updated in YouTrack, types absent here are deleted. When omitted, work item types are read from the API and stored as computed state.

days_a_week.description: Number of working days a week reported by the server.

first_day_of_week.description: Index of the first day of week reported by the server.

id.description: Work time settings identifier.

minutes_a_day.description: Number of minutes in a working day.

work_days.description: Indexes of working days in week. Sunday is 0, Monday is 1, and so on.

block.description: YouTrack global time tracking settings resource. This resource manages the global work time schedule and exposes related global work item type and attribute data.

aggregation.description: Whether the issue link type represents an aggregation relation.

directed.description: Whether the issue link type is directed.

id.description: The ID of the issue link type.

localized_name.description: Localized name of the issue link type, if available.

localized_source_to_target.description: Localized outward name of the issue link type, if available.

localized_target_to_source.description: Localized inward name of the issue link type, if available.

name.description: The name of the issue link type.

read_only.description: Whether the issue link type is read-only in YouTrack.

source_to_target.description: The outward name of the issue link type.

target_to_source.description: The inward name of the issue link type.

block.description: YouTrack issue link type resource. This resource manages issue link types.

community.description: Whether this is a community-contributed locale

id.description: Locale identifier (e.g., 'en_US', 'fr_FR')

block.description: YouTrack locale settings configuration

auto_join.description: Whether matching users are auto-joined to this group.

auto_join_domain.description: Domain used for automatic joining. Typically used with auto_join.

id.description: YouTrack ID of the group (computed)

own_user_logins.description: Direct users in the group, identified by login.

require_two_factor_authentication.description: Whether users in this group must use two-factor authentication.

sub_group_names.description: Direct subgroups of this group, identified by group name.

updaters.description: Users or groups that can update this group. Values are resolved by user login first, then group name.

viewers.description: Users or groups that can view this group. Values are resolved by user login first, then group name.

block.description: YouTrack nested group resource. Manages a group and its direct membership via user logins and subgroup names.

from.description: Email address to use in the From field

host.description: Mail server DNS name or IP address

id.description: Notification settings identifier

mail_protocol.description: Mail protocol to use (e.g., SMTP, IMAP)

reply_to.description: Email address to use in the Reply-To field

block.description: YouTrack mail server configuration

from_email.description: The email address used to send notifications for the project.

id.description: The entity ID of the project.

leader_login.description: The login (username) of the user to set as the project owner.

reply_to_email.description: The reply-to email address for project notifications.

short_name.description: The short name (prefix) of the project. Used as the prefix for issue IDs. Cannot be changed after creation.

template.description: Whether this project is a template.

block.description: YouTrack project resource. Manages a YouTrack project including its settings.

bundle_name.description: The name of the bundle to use for this project custom field. Overrides the default bundle from the global custom field. Supported for EnumProjectCustomField and StateProjectCustomField.

can_be_empty.description: Whether the custom field can have an empty value.

default_value_names.description: Default values set for new issues. Values are resolved by name from the effective bundle. Supported for EnumProjectCustomField and StateProjectCustomField.

empty_field_text.description: The placeholder text shown when the field has an empty value.

field_name.description: The name of the global custom field to attach to the project.

field_type.description: The $type of the ProjectCustomField to create (e.g., EnumProjectCustomField, StateProjectCustomField). If omitted, it is derived from the global custom field type.

id.description: The entity ID of the project custom field attachment.

is_public.description: Whether basic Read/Update Issue permissions are sufficient to access this field.

project_id.description: The entity ID of the project to attach the custom field to.

block.description: YouTrack project custom field resource. Attaches a global custom field to a project.

enabled.description: Whether time tracking is enabled for this project.

estimate_field_name.description: The name of the custom field attached to the project to use for estimation.

id.description: The entity ID of the project time tracking settings.

project_id.description: The entity ID of the project.

time_spent_field_name.description: The name of the custom field attached to the project to use for tracking spent time.

block.description: YouTrack project time tracking settings resource. Manages time tracking configuration for a project.

allow_all_origins.description: Whether to allow CORS requests from all origins

allowed_origins.description: List of allowed origins for CORS requests

id.description: REST settings identifier

block.description: YouTrack REST API settings configuration

id.description: YouTrack ID of the role (computed)

name.description: The display name of the role

permissions.description: List of permission names to assign to this role. The permissions are the ones available in YouTrack, e.g. 'Read Issues', 'Create Issues', etc.

block.description: YouTrack role resource. This resource manages a single role in YouTrack, which defines a set of permissions that can be assigned to users.

holder_login.description: The login (username) of the user or name of the group to assign the role to

holder_type.description: The type of the holder: 'user' or 'group'. If not specified, will try user first, then group.

id.description: YouTrack ID of the role assignment (computed)

role_id.description: The ID of the role to assign (e.g. youtrack_role.my_role.id)

role_name.description: The name of the assigned role (computed)

block.description: YouTrack role assignment resource. This resource manages role assignments with ONLY global scope in YouTrack, which assigns a role to a user or group.

id.description: The ID of the state bundle.

is_updateable.description: Whether current user can update this bundle.

archived.description: Whether this state value is archived.

id.description: state value ID.

is_resolved.description: Whether issues in this state are considered resolved.

block.description: YouTrack state bundle resource. This resource manages sets of state values.

administrator_email.description: Email address of the YouTrack administrator.

allow_statistics_collection.description: Indicates whether YouTrack is allowed to collect usage statistics. Default is false.

base_url.description: Base URL of the YouTrack instance.

id.description: System settings identifier (always 'global').

is_application_read_only.description: Indicates whether the YouTrack application is in read-only mode. Default is false.

max_export_items.description: Maximum number of items that can be exported at once. Default is 1000.

max_upload_file_size.description: Maximum file size (in bytes) that can be uploaded to YouTrack. Default is 10485760 (10MB).

block.description: YouTrack system settings resource. This resource manages the global system settings in YouTrack, such as administrator email, maximum export items, and other global configurations.

id.description: The Hub ID of the group.

name.description: The name of the YouTrack user group.

block.description: Retrieves information about a YouTrack user group by name.

full_name.description: The display name of the user.

id.description: The Hub ID of the user.

login.description: The login (username) of the YouTrack user.

block.description: Retrieves information about a YouTrack user by login.
